Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer failed to follow the Orchestrator’s instruction to look up DHL rates and instead clicked a FedEx link, diverting the workflow. This misnavigation led to repeated interactions with the FedEx page and subsequent failure to obtain USPS and DHL rates, causing stagnation and preventing identification of the correct cheapest option (USPS at $41.75).
